evidence.pin_and_recipe_integrity: Immutability is assumed via pins; all S/n pins are re-verified before and after build, and len/set/52 checks plus per-member hash checks are present.
evidence.compile_scope: Only candidate_trees.c is copied as source_dir/trees.c and compiled with recipe sflags/includes; asserted trees.lo SHA equals the pinned a38a... value.
evidence.preservation_and_order: All 52 names copied to build first; link argv iterates names in recipe order; changed-list assertion confirms only trees.lo differs; parent re-verified unchanged.
evidence.codec: Link uses cflags, -shared, soname, version-script, and ordered names; final lib SHA asserted against recipe candidate e1d8... value.
evidence.no_activation: Only new output dir is written; no install, LD_PRELOAD, or default activation; env scrubs LD_PRELOAD.
evidence.error_surface: check=True, timeouts, and finally-write receipt exist; traceback captured to FAIL receipt.

limitations: Source review cannot certify builder behavior on absent environment/recipe values; correctness depends on trusted source-pins.json and REPRODUCTION_INPUTS.json contents not shown.

out.parents symlink assertion does not prove out.parent chain contains no symlinked components beyond those parents; out.absolute() does not resolve symlinks, so a symlink in an ancestor could route writes unexpectedly if untrusted caller controls path (contract says caller is deliberate/trusted, so not a defect here).
assert statements use BaseException-adjacent control flow but Python -O would disable asserts; not evidenced as run under -O.
Evidence that trees.lo changed and others unchanged relies on source-pins parent artifacts being as described; actual hashes not independently verifiable in this review.
Concurrent modification of parent/shared artifacts between pre-check and post-check is not fully excluded; post-check narrows but does not prove no transient mutation during build.
